notes: AJIO Home (India) has NO genuine Pet Care category/department. Checked: (1) robots.txt - no Claude-specific disallow, generic bot rules only; (2) full mega-menu nav tree recovered from window.APP_DATA/reduxData.content.navigation on the homepage - scanned all 613 unique 'display' node names across every department (Men, Women, Kids, Electronics, Bags & Accessories, Jewellery, AJIO Beauty, Home & Lifestyle incl. Bath/Bed Linen/Brands/Carpet-Rugs/Curtains/Cushions/Dining/Festive Gifts/Gardening & Planters/Home Decor/Kitchen/Stationery) - zero 'Pet'/'Pets'/'Pet Care' department or sub-category exists anywhere in the real navigation; (4) enumerated the site's own category+webcategory XML sitemaps (from robots.txt's declared Sitemap: entries) via gzip download and grepped for pet/dog/cat-related slugs - found only 5 'pet'-named nodes, none of them genuine Pet Care categories: 'Pet Rugs' (/c/pet-rugs-5819-89821, 4,002 items) and 'Pet Picks' (/c/pet-picks-1785848355, 2,691 items) are non-discriminating marketing catch-alls with product titles/facets that are 100% generic home textiles (bath towels, comforters, dohars, table runners, kids shorts) and zero pet products visible; 'Pets Rakhi' (/c/pets-rakhi-1786083358, 10 items) is dog/paw-print-themed Rakhi festival wristbands for human wear (Shop For: Men/Boys) - pet-themed, not pet care, and festive/religious; 'Pet Mom (Pet Accessories)' (/c/pet-mom-pet-accessories-1777008764, 1,208 items) is another generic catch-all (Wall & Table Decor, Table Covers, Rugs, Bath Mats, Bedsheets facets, zero pet items visible); 'Pet Mom' (/c/pet-mom-5775-44911, 64 items) is a mixed Mother's-Day-style gift curation containing 2 genuine pet-bed products (Kuber Industries Cotton Foldable Pet Bed, Rectangular Pet Bed) alongside unrelated carpets/serveware/bathroom-accessories/table-napkins with no pet connection - this is a curated marketing/gift landing page (orphan URL, not linked from the real nav tree, no clean pet-specific facet), matching the brief's 'Navigation/marketing pages are never a category, even inside a Pet section' exclusion rule, so it was not emitted as a row despite containing some genuine pet products. This is absence-by-exhaustive-check, not a zero-result site-search false negative: real navigation, mega menu, and sitemap were all checked per the brief's requirement. No pet-food/consumable or medical/veterinary categories were found either. Conclusion: AJIO Home carries essentially zero standalone Pet Care assortment; whatever pet products exist (a couple of pet beds) are buried inside unrelated marketing collections, not a real category the site itself recognizes.
